q2.citation: GD second-quarter Form 10-Q cover and six-month cash-flow statement.

q3.citation: GD third-quarter Form 10-Q cover, cash-flow statement, Notes H and I, and Part II Item 2. Q3 cash flows are nine months less six months.

lease.citation: GD FY2025 Form 10-K Note J current finance lease liability at December 31, 2025. Used as the annual principal cash-flow proxy.

elapsed.rationale: Base scenario estimates no new borrowing, principal repayments or net carrying adjustment. At October 4 commercial paper was zero and the next listed fixed-rate maturity was April 2027. Other debt and available borrowing capacity still exist.

remaining.rationale: Base scenario assumes no additional borrowing or principal repayment by year-end. Hold Note H carrying debt flat. Finance lease principal is handled separately.
